CONSERVATIVE.assumptions_explanation: Target usage 16.2% vs. current 12.5% (ratio 1.30x, if current usage is positive). With touch elasticity e=0.60, 60% of the proportional role change is assumed to become additional decision touches, giving a touch multiplier H=1.18. Pass tendency is then changed by +10%. Role saturation (k=0.85) retains 80% of baseline efficiency at this touch multiplier, and turnover risk grows by +25% relative to baseline. All of this is SIMULATED -- a conditional projection under these explicit assumptions, never a forecast.

efficiency_retention_used.method: exp(-k * max(0, H-1)) unless explicitly overridden
